messages:
Priya: incident-bot just fired a page for az4 - automated severity P1. Observability shows surge in 5xx from serving pool and kvcache evictions. paging PD escalation chain. :rotating_light:
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident INC-5321 triggered (P1) — service: inference-az4-serving, symptom: 5xx spike / eviction-rate high. Routed to oncall. /link to alert
pagerduty: PagerDuty alert: INC-5321 — acknowledged by Ethan at 1723456802
Ethan: acked, jumping in. summary please? anyone seeing customer-facing errors?
Priya: quick TL;DR: spikes started ~1723456740, error-rate 5xx >= 8% over 2m, kvcache eviction rate doubled, a few model shards evicting. Latency also up for long-tail requests. No full region outage yet but errors affecting ~12% of requests.
Siva: grabbing logs from shards. running `kubectl get pods -n serving -l az=az4` now.
Danielle: tagging billing & sales for potential customer impact. Which customers hit the higher error bucket?
Priya: running an ad-hoc query against request logs: `SELECT customer_id, count(*) FROM requests WHERE ts > now() - interval '5 minutes' AND status >= 500 GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 10;` initial top impacted: corp-ark (heavy), tinychat-inc (moderate), dev-playground (light).
Ethan: thanks. Can we divert traffic from az4 to az2 as a protection? what's the cost of that route?
Siva: we have routing policy `region-fallback` enabled. I can flip canary -> divert for az4 but need approval. Command to change routing policy: ```sh
redwoodctl routing set --region az4 --fallback az2 --mode divert --reason "P1 az4 eviction surge"
```
Danielle: +1 for divert. Pinged legal/comms for customer messaging.
Ethan: go ahead Siva, execute and monitor. I'll stay on thread.
Siva: executing now. `redwoodctl routing set ...` -> api confirms change, id=route-op-934.
incident-bot: Routing policy updated: az4 -> az2 divert engaged. Estimated migration window ~45s.
Priya: seeing immediate drop in 5xx for requests routed to az2, overall errors trending down from 8% -> 3% in first 90s. Some requests still hitting az4 (sticky sessions).
Ethan: good. Initiate graceful drain of serving nodes in az4 to reduce evictions. Command: ```sh
redwoodctl nodes drain --region az4 --selector "eviction_rate>0.05" --grace 60
```
Siva: drain submitted. Draining 12 nodes. Watching logs.
Priya: note: cache warmup to az2 will increase token cost briefly. Ops aware?
Danielle: ops-cc'd. Comms drafting incident note to affected customers, include timeline and mitigation steps.
Ethan: PD escalation suppressed now that we've got divert and drain in progress. ETA for full stabilization?
Siva: metrics returning to baseline in routing-divert path. kvcache evictions dropping, QPS handled by az2. I expect 10-15m for full warmup and fallback validation.
Priya: quick post-mortem checklist: capture shards that evicted, check model memory/quant settings, review autoscaler thresholds. tagging infra/ml for follow-up.
Danielle: added incident to statuspage draft: short note + next update in 10m. cc @sales-team for impacted customers list.
Ethan: handing off to night oncall (Danielle) at +30m. I'll remain reachable if escalation rekindles.
Danielle: acknowledged handoff. I'll monitor and coordinate with cust success if any tickets spike.
incident-bot: Incident INC-5321 status: mitigated (routing divert + node drain). PD alert suppressed. Please add full timeline to the incident doc.
Priya: adding timeline to incident doc now. Final note: plan a controlled rollback of divert once caches warmed; we'll run an A/B check before full failback.
Siva: noted — will prepare failback plan: incremental 10% traffic steps, monitoring 5xx & eviction metrics.
Ethan: thanks all. :thumbsup:
Danielle: updating customers and closing PD when confirmed stable.
incident-bot: Reminder: create postmortem ticket INC-5321-PM assigned to Siva + Priya + Ethan.
